Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
The bid is to be submitted through GOK KPPP platform www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in only.
Tenderers who have not registered in the GOK KPPP portal should be registered through web site www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in

The Tenderer should obtain tender documents through KPPP web site www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in . in at free of cost. Additional conditions and informations also can be obtained through the above mentioned website.
Bidders / Contractors submit the bid on the website itself (for help on KPPP / e-payment, please contact helpdesk No. 08025501216 and 080 25501227 from Monday to Saturday during 9.00 AM to 9.00 PM.)

Tender application cost will not be refundable or exchangeable in case of cancellation of tender.
All materials should be in good quality as per specification, quality certificate for the same should be obtained from the concerned authority at their own cost.

The work should be carried out in accordance with the standard specifications specified by the department. Maintenance period from the contractor for the above works is 1 year from the date of completion of work.
Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.
More details should be collected from the office at working hours
The Executive Engineer rights accept and reject the tender without intimation or information
The Executive Engineer PRE SIRSI Division SIRSI invites tenders from eligible tenderers who have been registered in KPWD with kppp portal for the construction of works

Contractor should made an agreement within 20 days of tender acceptance date and work should be carried out immediately after Signing agreement. If not tender will be cancelled at the contractors own risk and cost
GST Shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
The Contractor should scan the KPWD Registration Copy.
The Contractor should scan the PAN Card and GST No.
Contractors Postal Address and Mobile No.

Bidder can access tender documents on the website, fill them and submit the completed tender document into electronic tender on the website https://www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in/ after submitting the EMD and tender processing fee in the form of e-payment. EMD will be refunded only after acceptance of successful bidder.

If the rates quoted by the Contractor is lesser than the amount put to tender the difference cost (Additional Security Deposit) should be paid by the contractor through FDR in the favor of Executive Engineer at the time of Agreement

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity should be not less than Rs: 25.13 lakhs
Line of credit : Liquid assets and or availabilty of credit facilties of not less than 30% of the amount of contract ie, Rs: 7.54 lakhs (Certificates from Nationalized banks)

nature of work : Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar work such as RETAINING WALL/ BRIDGE/ BOX CULVERT work of value not less than 50% of the cost of work i.e., Rs. 12.56 lakhs during last five years.
